lines.speaker: board
lines.text: ARCHERY: press 3 to draw the bow, face a target and press J to shoot. Arrows fly in a straight line, so line yourself up first.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: Stand on the red line. The near targets are about 8 tiles away and the far ones about 14.

lines.speaker: board
lines.text: K fires three arrows in a spread. An arrow stops at the first thing it hits, so a near target can shield a far one.
